message: Last week, we had a surprise blackout during dinner, and for once, I was actually ready! I whipped out my trusty power bank to keep my phone charged, and we had enough flashlights and lanterns to light up the whole house. It felt good to be the one who was prepared instead of scrambling in the dark! 😊 Have you ever had a moment where you were the prepared one? What’s your favorite tip for staying comfy during a power outage?
